text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + 429 rates detected on api-gateway-us-east-1 for /v1/generate (rolling 5m 5xx=9%, 429s up 12x). Potential cascade from quota service. Pager triggered for SRE.
oncall-eng: ack i'm up, joining. linking dashboards: https://grafana/internal/d/api-gateway
alice: @oncall-eng i rolled a global quota rule ~18m ago (commit abc1234) but scoped to canary set. didn't expect fanout.
miguel: digging in traces — quota-controller returning 500s while validating policies. downstream gateway treating errors as hard-deny -> 429/5xx mix. grabbing logs now.
sre-jen: can someone run a quick listing of active rules? i'm afraid a bad merge created a policy loop.

miguel: running query against quota admin:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://quota-admin.internal/v1/rules | jq '.[] | select(.target=="global")'
```
found a rule with `max_tokens: null` and `merge_strategy: fail_on_none` — suspicious.

alice: ugh that was me — i added a fail-fast merge yesterday for canaries, must not have defaulted. will start rollback if needed.

oncall-eng: temp mitigation plan: 1) revert quota merge behavior (rollback abc1234) 2) add permissive fallback so quota-service errors return 200 with soft limits instead of deny 3) route heavy customers to fallback pool. executing now.
tara: i'll open a quick patch to set `merge_strategy: permissive` and bump token bucket size for prod tenants. patch snippet:
```
PATCH /v1/rules/global
{ "merge_strategy": "permissive", "max_tokens": 200000 }
```

ops-bot: rollback job started for deploy abc1234 -> status: in_progress (job id: rollback-379111)

customer-success: looping in CS triage — notifying top-10 tenants impacted (they're seeing increased 429). drafting message to customers now.
paul: flagging legal & security to confirm no sensitive requests dropped, but likely only throttling. also notify sales for any escalations.

sre-jen: logs show NPE in policy merger at quota-service line 218 (java): `policy.getLimit().getTokens()` when limit is null. throwing 500, gateway returns 429 on enforcement. snippet:
```
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "Limit.getTokens()" because "policy.getLimit()" is null
 at com.redwood.quota.PolicyMerger.merge(PolicyMerger.java:218)
```

oncall-eng: mitigation applied: rollback complete, permissive fallback enabled, token buckets bumped. observing metrics:
- 5xx dropped from 9% -> 1.1% in 6 minutes
- 429s down 85% in same window
:white_check_mark: traffic now stable but continuing to monitor for 30m.

alice: i'm opening a hotfix PR to add null-safety and default limit semantics. will follow with unit tests and an integration test that simulates missing limit fields.

miguel: baseline check: no matrix of customer errors > 1% now. running synthetic requests to confirm end-to-end (curl to gateway + expect 200).

customer-success: first batch of customers notified with ETA for full resolution and cc support engineers. no major escalations yet.

paul: please add follow-ups to postmortem: 1) stricter CI for quota schema, 2) circuit-breaker so quota-service 5xx doesn't translate to denies, 3) runbook update for immediate rollback vs permissive fallback.

ops-bot: incident status updated -> severity: reduced; pager quieted.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Root cause: quota merge behavior introduced a null-limit path (bad config from recent canary change) causing quota-service 500s and gateway-level 429/5xx cascade. Mitigations: rollback of commit abc1234, permissive fallback enabled, token bucket bump, routing heavy tenants to fallback pool. Impact: transient 429/5xx on public inference API for ~22 minutes, partial customer throttling. Next steps: postmortem with action items and deploy hotfix (alice).

oncall-eng: i'll keep the war-room open for another 45 minutes. if no regression, will close and hand to eng-sre for postmortem coordination. :eyes:
